evidence.explanation: In the tested normal rectangular-room environment, get_location delegates to the default somexy picker and get_free_room_loc normalizes the same supplied coordinate environment. Missing direct-call/extra-environment-helper edges do not imply a coordinate or retry divergence in this domain. Two keys share one room-coordinate delegation cause.
evidence.proof: Exact ten C coordinate/eligibility helper bodies versus production JS exports. 204 target comparisons: explicit or random initial location on a dry fountain, then success on each fallback attempt1..101 or101 failures before scheduled success102. C/JS agree on coordinates, failure and draw count. Actual room contains14 floor cells and one fountain; no invalid empty-room premise. Whole room_coordinates.js is unchanged from the frozen scanner base.
evidence.control: Four direct-floor controls (explicit/random initial position, early/late unused success tape) return10,6 with0/2 draws and no fallback. C panic adapter longjmps to record nonreturning failure; no diagnostic-string/error-runtime parity claim. Shared legal draw tape tests consumption, not independent RNG. Regular5x3 room only, no objects/subrooms/irregularity/water-level/custom picker; no full caller placement/finalization/runtime claim.
